title: ADL Lift Services Limited
description: ADL Lift Services Limited is a Scotland-based commercial lift specialist, incorporated in 2010 and now headquartered in Bellshill at Strathclyde Business Park, that under the leadership of Brian Harkin employs around 40 people with assets and shareholders’ funds in the low-millions-of-pounds range, focuses on Glasgow and other major Scottish cities while offering UK-wide 24-hour emergency call-out, and provides full-lifecycle passenger, goods, service, accessibility and bespoke lift design and installation, maintenance, repairs and modernisation for commercial properties, local authorities, health boards and housing associations, holding credentials such as LEIA membership, ISO 9001/45001 and Safecontractor, primarily through adlliftservices.com (with adlliftservices.co.uk redirecting there).
